d:
Bihar vidhanasbha chunav men aarjedi ke khate men mahaz 25 siten aaeen. tejasvi yadav ke lie ye chunav natije kisi jhatke se kam nahin honge. tejasvi ke netritv men aarjedi tin vidhanasbha chunav lar chuki hai aur is bar uska pradarshan sabse zyada nirashajnak raha hai. aakhir tejasvi yadav se kahan chuk ho gaee aur aarjedi ko ab aage ki rah kis tarah tay karni hogi?
Riport rajnish kumar
Vidiyoh navin negi aur nimit vats
